facts.fact: The General Application and Implementation Directive 2025 issued under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 has been in force since September 2025.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is doing the supervisory job: it receives Compliance Audit Returns and licenses Data Protection Compliance Organisations.

The NDPC issued compliance notices in 2025, named 649 higher-education institutions in February 2026 for documentation within 21 days, publishes organisations that have filed returns and issues annual compliance marks, according to Blessing Udo.
